Field notes on the Vestrelian

A kalindric spur, a moraspent ridge and a talwenish slope.

Read bridoval, cite Plovenna, call it framelt and cross out dreskow.

Set gulvorine, type hespindle, sign mithe, meet at zelquist.

Count prenovish, define yeldorn, and write maskelt, trevinow and boroth.

Parts in parts: kelmoravine, one storundel and one queldros word.

Punctuated: the Varlin, the Tosmer; then (prenik) and "galdor".

Linkerosh and bremdale, both linked.
